children: Tesla (TSLA) delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2. Company cites large software user base tied to deliveries as potential recurring revenue. Notes ongoing EU regulatory developments.

TSLA fell ~6% after the NHTSA opened an investigation into Cybercab's technical data and certification process, prompting trader attention to regulatory risk and potential impact on vehicle rollout.
Slovenia granted temporary type approval for Tesla’s FSD Supervised system for public roads. Rollout to begin soon under regulatory oversight, focusing on safety and gradual deployment.
Tesla (TSLA) AI lead Ashok Elluswamy says self-driving hinges on intelligence, not sensors. Tesla uses an AI-first, end-to-end camera-based driving stack and rejects lidar.
Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) exported 36,119 vehicles produced at its Shanghai plant in August, reflecting continued outbound shipments from its China manufacturing operations as EV exports expand overseas.
